yt_title: Day 7 of 10 — Six O'Clock | Anaya's Ten Days EP04
short:
Seven days left.

The other buyer was coming at six o'clock.
So she got there first — and waited eight hours on a step.

Ten to six. Five to six. Six o'clock.
And nobody came.
cta:
Then she heard footsteps behind her 🧡
EP5 tomorrow ✦
